d:
The Razr Fold is Motorola’s first foldable phone — but surprisingly, it doesn’t feel like a first attempt at all. In fact, in a lot of ways, it feels like Motorola’s trying to fix what’s wrong with foldables.
With flagship-grade cameras borrowed from the Motorola Signature, a larger and brighter cover display, excellent battery life, fast charging, refined software, stylus support, and strong performance… the Razr Fold gets a lot right.
